meta.name: diplomatic-survival-at-banquet
meta.description: Use when navigating a hostile banquet, diplomatic ambush, or dangerous political gathering. Guides escape from the Hongmen Banquet (鸿门宴) scenario using alliances, deference, and covert withdrawal.

copy.tagline: 在敌对宴会中安全脱身
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需在复杂社交场合中保护自己
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to protect yourself in complex social situations

howto.what: 引导你从危险的宴会或政治集会中安全脱身，教你提前结交盟友、准备退路、表现谦卑、制造借口悄悄离开，并留人善后维持表面。
howto.when: 当你身处敌对宴会、外交伏击或危险的政治聚会，需要隐蔽撤退以避免冲突时。

say.text: 帮我从一场鸿门宴中脱身，我要提前布局盟友。
say.note: 你会收到结交盟友和准备退路的建议。

say.text: 我需要在宴会上找借口离开，但又不想得罪主人。
say.note: 你会得到如何得体退场的步骤。

howto.what_en: Guides you to escape from a dangerous banquet or political gathering safely, teaching you to build alliances in advance, prepare escape routes, show deference, create plausible excuses, leave quietly, and leave someone behind to maintain appearances.
howto.when_en: When you are in a hostile banquet, diplomatic ambush, or dangerous political gathering and need to covertly withdraw without conflict.

say_en.text: Help me escape from a Hongmen Banquet by arranging allies beforehand.
say_en.note: You'll receive advice on building allies and planning escapes.

say_en.text: I need an excuse to leave the banquet without offending the host.
say_en.note: You'll get steps for a graceful exit.
